page.layout: One printed page of text. Running head at top, centred over a woodcut headpiece. Title block centred below it, then one column of running text. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: ORATIO IX. DE MISSIONE SPIRITUS SANCTI.
Publicè recitata ab OTTHONE GYSONE Marchiaco. 29. Maij. 1585.
main_text.p: LAUDABILI ac inveterata consuetudine hujus celeberrimæ & antiquiss. Academiæ, viri Amplis. patres in Christo Reverendi. Nobilissimi ac doctissimi auditores, receptum est, ut hoc solenni ac faustissimo Pentecostes tempore, (quod iterum Dei gratia nobis illuxit) aliquid vestris auribus dignum, in hoc laudatissimo congressu, dicatur, uti omnium nostrum animi, ad considerationem summi & ineffabilis beneficii, quod ante annos plus minus quinquaginta supra millesimum quingentesimum, Filius Dei apud Ecclesiam suam benignissimè posuit, misso in Apostolos visibili specie Spiritu S. inflamme-tur. Est certè id miraculum accuratiore consideratione dignissimum: quia consolationis ac doctrinæ plenissimum: Itaq; imminente nuper hoc

page.notes: Running head read as "LIBER IV." (printed letters are spaced and partly worn). Page number "625" is partly worn; the reading is probable but not certain. "inflamme-tur" is split at the line end; the printed hyphen is kept, and the letter before "tur" is slightly worn. The catchword "solenni" is set alone at the lower right. The ornament above the title is a woodcut headpiece and is not transcribed. The title block is one division; the subtitle line is set in italic and small capitals, shown as level 2.
